exclusion.reason: npm install hits an ERESOLVE peer conflict (lucide-react@0.307.0 wants react <=18 but root uses react 19), and the build then fails because @stripe/stripe-js and @stripe/react-stripe-js are imported but not resolved; these are the repo's own dependency declarations, not credentials or a private registry.
